text: Writing the real incident postmortem and on-call runbook for the VoltPay checkout failure.
A factual, blameless timeline: VoltPay's outage at 1:30, Support flagging it by 2:05, the orders database confirming a failure rate 40 times normal by 2:25, resolved by 3:00.
The root cause was a mismatch between two reasonable decisions -- checkout-api's deliberate 200 on a handled failure, and an alert that was only ever built to catch non-2xx status.
Ownership is named by person: Marcus and Ananya own monitoring and alerting going forward, Lin Chao's team owns checkout-api's own failure-reporting improvements.
Next: the series finale -- what shipped, and what's still manual.
